name: dsh-plugin-prompt-guard
description: Keeps pending permission/approval and multiselect prompts visible in dsh web — if one disappears without being answered it is restored in place or a bar offers one-tap restore; plus browser notifications when a prompt appears while the tab is in the background, and a host-side push (ntfy.sh) when the agent needs the user and no browser client is open. Settings card for the ntfy topic/token/cooldown.
